# code-listing

## `CodeListing` vs `CatNListing`

Two entry points, split by what you're holding:

- **`CodeListing({ code, startLine, filePath })`** — for raw text. `startLine`
  is the line number of `code`'s first line (default `1`).
- **`CatNListing({ content, filePath })`** — for `cat -n` tool output
  (`<number>\t<text>` per line, e.g. the Read tool, `edited_text_file`). Parses
  it and renders `CodeListing`.

Don't hand `cat -n` output to `CodeListing`, or raw text to `CatNListing` — each
parses/renders its own format only.

## Plugin reference

- Description: Renders `cat -n` tool output (`CatNListing`) as a syntax-highlighted, line-numbered listing: parses the gutter off and hands the code to syntax-highlight's `CodeListing`.
- Web:
  - Uses: `primitives/syntax-highlight.CodeListing`
  - Exports (values): `CatNListing`
- Cross-plugin:
  - Imported by:
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/attachment/edited-text-file`
    - `conversations/conversation-view/jsonl-viewer/tool-call/read`
